verdict.rationale: Gumloop is documented as an AI agent platform where agents get a goal and a set of tools. The agent decides which tools to call, drawing on connectors such as Gmail, Salesforce and Slack, any MCP server, and a code sandbox, and can be automated with triggers, schedules and webhooks. Model choice is evidenced through an OpenAI-compatible chat completions surface that routes to Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini and OpenRouter models, plus bring-your-own API keys. Missing for 10: explicit docs for placing LLM/agent steps as nodes inside a multi-step workflow builder, per-step model selection in the agent or workflow UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
